verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway routes every MCP call through the platform and logs it, so you can see what your agents are doing. That gives a basic observability foundation for consumed and hosted servers. However, no evidence shows an analytics dashboard or aggregated metrics, missing for 10: call-volume metrics, per-user breakdowns, error rates/error analytics, cost reporting, analytics for published servers' consumers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
